title: Kausal IDHS: design-based causal graph discovery and confounder selection for complex survey data
description: Configuration-driven Python pipeline (code and locked analysis plan) for the study 'Survey-design-calibrated independence tests reduce adjustment-set validity in PC-based causal discovery'. It implements design-corrected conditional-independence tests (Rao-Scott, design t test), PC-stable with temporal tiers, seven confounder-selection strategies, cross-fitted AIPW with design-based standard errors, and a simulation benchmark mimicking the 2017 Indonesia Demographic and Health Survey. IDHS microdata are not included and must be requested from The DHS Program.
